## 4. Architecture Limitations

| Limitation | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| **In-memory state** | Investigations lost on restart | Add SQLite via `node:sqlite` (already in stack) |
| **Single project (InsightBoard only)** | Demo limited to 3 bugs | Multi-project endpoint already has PROJECTS array |
| **JS/TS analysis only** | Can't analyse Python/Go | Accept limitation for demo, document clearly |
| **No authentication** | Single-user only | Acceptable for hackathon; document in README |
| **No WebSocket** | SSE only | SSE is sufficient; acceptable |
| **No CI/CD integration** | No GitHub/GitLab hooks | Document as future work |
| **Workspace copy** (not live repo) | Changes isolated to workspace | Correct design; document clearly |

## 8. Industry Gap Analysis

| Platform | Key Pattern | FixFlow Equivalent | Differentiation |
|---|---|---|---|
| GitHub Copilot | Inline AI suggestions | FixFlow proposes full change plan | FixFlow explains WHY, not just WHAT |
| Cursor | Chat-driven code editing | FixFlow uses evidence-first investigation | FixFlow is evidence-backed, not chat-driven |
| Sourcegraph | Code search + intelligence | FixFlow Code Intelligence | FixFlow connects search TO fix workflow |
| Sentry | Error tracking + stack traces | FixFlow Evidence Agent | FixFlow uses evidence to drive full fix lifecycle |
| SonarQube | Static analysis findings | FixFlow findings from agents | FixFlow connects findings to approvals + implementation |
| Datadog | Monitoring + alerting | FixFlow Incident concept | FixFlow connects incidents to engineering workflow |
| Linear/Jira | Issue tracking | FixFlow Investigation workflow | FixFlow's issue IS the investigation (not separate) |
| LaunchDarkly | Feature flags | FixFlow release concepts | FixFlow connects release to full test+security cycle |

**FixFlow's Unique Differentiator:** The only platform that connects INVESTIGATION → EVIDENCE → ROOT CAUSE → CHANGE PLAN → APPROVAL → IMPLEMENTATION → TESTS → REGRESSION → REPORT in one connected workflow with human-in-the-loop control at exactly one point.
